nodes.summary: Let $S$ be a semigroup and let $\beta S$ be the set of ultrafilters on $S$, with the product for which $D \in pq$ exactly when $\{x \in S : \{y \in S : xy \in D\} \in q\} \in p$. A two-sided ideal of $\beta S$ is a set $I \subseteq \beta S$ with $rq \in I$ and $qr \in I$ for all $q \in I$ and $r \in \beta S$. A set $D \subseteq S$ is central when some $p \in \beta S$ with $pp = p$ lies in every nonempty two-sided…
nodes.title: Central sets in a semigroup

nodes.summary: Let $S$ be a semigroup and let $\beta S$ be the set of ultrafilters on $S$, with the product for which $D \in pq$ exactly when $\{x \in S : \{y \in S : xy \in D\} \in q\} \in p$. Let $J(S)$ be the set of ultrafilters on $S$ all of whose members are $J$-sets. A set $D \subseteq S$ is a $C$-set when $D \in p$ for some $p \in J(S)$ with $pp = p$.
nodes.title: C-sets in a semigroup

nodes.summary: If $S$ is a nonempty semigroup, then $S$ is a $J$-set in $S$.
nodes.title: A nonempty semigroup is a J-set in itself

nodes.summary: A set $D$ in a semigroup $S$ is a $J$-set when for every nonempty finite set $F$ of sequences $f : \mathbb{N} \to S$, where $\mathbb{N} = \{0, 1, 2, \dots\}$, there are an integer $m \ge 1$, elements $a_1, \dots, a_{m+1} \in S$ and indices $t_1 < \dots < t_m$ in $\mathbb{N}$ such that $a_1 f(t_1) a_2 f(t_2) \cdots a_m f(t_m) a_{m+1} \in D$ for every $f \in F$.
nodes.title: J-sets in a semigroup

nodes.summary: If $S$ is a nonempty semigroup, then $S$ is a piecewise syndetic subset of $S$.
nodes.title: A nonempty semigroup is piecewise syndetic in itself

nodes.summary: A set $D$ in a semigroup $S$ is piecewise syndetic when there is a finite set $G \subseteq S$ such that for every finite set $F \subseteq S$ there is $x \in S$ with $Fx \subseteq \bigcup_{t \in G} t^{-1} D$, where $Fx = \{fx : f \in F\}$ and $t^{-1} D = \{s \in S : ts \in D\}$.
nodes.title: Piecewise syndetic subsets of a semigroup

nodes.summary: In every semigroup $S$, the empty subset of $S$ is not central.
nodes.title: The empty set is not central in a semigroup

nodes.summary: In every semigroup $S$, the empty subset of $S$ is not a $C$-set.
nodes.title: The empty set is not a C-set in a semigroup

nodes.summary: If $S$ is a nonempty semigroup, then the empty subset of $S$ is not a $J$-set.
nodes.title: The empty set is not a J-set in a nonempty semigroup

nodes.summary: In every semigroup $S$, the empty subset of $S$ is not piecewise syndetic.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
